name: Content Block Translation
description: Translate individual content blocks from Classical Chinese to English with cultural footnotes, including footnote marker validation and quality threshold enforcement
author: Translation Pipeline Team
changelog: Added external YAML configuration support with work-specific overrides

content_text_id.description: Unique identifier for this content block

content_source_text.description: Classical Chinese source text to translate

work_id.description: Work identifier for tracking and logging purposes

translated_data.description: Complete translation response with annotated content and footnotes

translated_annotated_content.annotated_content_text: string - English translation with inline markers [1], [2], etc.
translated_annotated_content.content_footnotes: array - Footnote definitions with ideogram, pinyin, explanation
translated_annotated_content.content_type: string - One of: narrative, dialogue, verse, document, descriptive, thought

validation_report.description: Validation results including footnote marker checks and quality score

manifest.description: Processing manifest with metadata, timing, quality metrics

metrics.description: Detailed metrics including character counts, length ratios, quality scores

attempts_used.description: Number of translation attempts before success or final failure

config_path.description: Explicit path to YAML configuration file

work_id.description: Work ID for work-specific configuration overrides

model.description: OpenAI model to use for translation (legacy parameter)

max_retries.description: Maximum number of translation attempts before failing (legacy parameter)

glossary_path.description: Optional path to wuxia glossary database (legacy parameter)

footnote_marker_validation.description: Validates footnote markers in translated text match footnotes array
checks: Count unique [N] markers in translated text
Marker count MUST equal footnote count

footnote_marker_consistency.description: Every footnote in the array must have a corresponding [N] marker in the text

quality_threshold.description: Translation quality must meet minimum threshold of 9.5/10

content_type_classification.description: Content must be classified into one of 6 types

usage_example.code:
from wrappers.content_block_translation_wrapper import ContentBlockTranslationWrapper

wrapper = ContentBlockTranslationWrapper(
    max_retries=5,
    quality_threshold=9.5
)

result = wrapper.execute(
    content_text_id=42,
    content_source_text="且言紂王只因進香之後，看見女媧美貌。",
    work_id="D1379"
)

if result.success:
    print(f"Quality: {result.validation_report.quality_score:.1f}/10")
    print(f"Footnotes: {result.validation_report.footnote_marker_count}")
    translated = result.translated_data
else:
    print(f"Error: {result.error_details}")
usage_example.description: Translate a single content block with automatic validation and retry

notes: Footnote validation happens BEFORE quality check (critical ordering)
Each retry attempt performs both footnote and quality validation
Wrapper handles retries internally; TranslationService configured for single attempt
Quality threshold is configurable but defaults to 9.5/10 per requirements
Validation failures are logged with detailed error context
Manifest includes full processing metadata for audit trail
